title: syntheses
universal_lens: The synthesis unifies behavioral target concentration and social opinion concentration via a shared Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) kernel. This structural isomorphism maps physical play-calling distributions to expert consensus vectors, treating both as probability simplices subject to Bayesian updating under isolated likelihood elicitation.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs the LEAP mechanism to perform tempered Bayesian updates on transcript-derived signals. By isolating per-item likelihoods and applying Leave-One-Out audits, GSI constructs conformal prediction sets that strictly gate trust-layer weights against pre-existing market priors.
gse_mapping: GSE translates HHI into situational state-transitions, calculating effective numerical advantages (EffN) and contextual deltas (e.g., trailing-4Q). The engine bridges these physical states with social opinion concentration, using profile-anchored priors to dynamically adjust defensive/offensive transition probabilities.

primitives.name: Transcript-First Trust Extraction
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Consequence:** the trust-signals extraction framework is architecturally transcript-first (ASR → diarization/ID → NLP claim extraction → structured signal record).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: ASR: Automatic Speech Recognition (dimensionless text); Diarization: Speaker ID mapping; NLP: Natural Language Processing operator.
primitives.assumptions: Audio/text contains higher-fidelity semantic truth than visual features for press conferences; video is secondary.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when ASR accuracy drops below operational thresholds or in highly non-verbal contexts where vision dominates.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw media ingestion directly to GSI's structured signal records, bypassing CV bottlenecks.
layer2.telemetry: Claim extraction F1-score vs. manual annotation.

primitives.name: Isolated Likelihood Elicitation & Audit
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## S2 — LEAP is the scoring mechanism; the market is the gate The corpus's news-fusion story, connected end to end: - **LEAP (0440)** gives the mechanism: per-item isolated likelihood elicitation → story-clustered tempered Bayesian update → LOO Δj audit trail.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: Likelihood function (dimensionless); P: Probability distribution; D_i: Isolated data item; \Delta_j: Leave-One-Out audit metric.
primitives.assumptions: Individual news items can be treated as independent likelihood operators before clustering; tempered priors prevent overfitting.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when news items are highly collinear or when the prior is completely orthogonal to the true data-generating process.

layer2.mapping: Forms the core Bayesian inference engine for GSI, ensuring rigorous calibration of incoming trust signals.
layer2.telemetry: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) reduction and Brier score delta.

primitives.name: Dual-Domain Concentration Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **BoRaEM (0530)** gives the per-source reliability concept (v1: sibling's TIER_PRIORS × tipster EMA; v2: joint EM).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: p_i: Share of targets or weight of expert opinion (dimensionless, sum to 1); EffN: Effective Numerical Advantage (integer/dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Both physical targeting and expert opinions form valid discrete probability distributions amenable to entropy/concentration metrics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur when N=1 (perfect concentration) causing zero variance, or when distributions are perfectly uniform yielding no predictive alpha.

layer2.mapping: Directly links GSE's physical situational awareness (target shares) with GSI's social sentiment aggregation (opinion HHI).
layer2.telemetry: Correlation between physical EffN and τ-weighted opinion HHI.

reasoning_traces.think:
The mathematical architecture of this synthesis rests on decoupling the signal source from the scoring mechanism. First, we establish the Transcript-First Trust Kernel, which asserts that the primary information manifold for trust lies in the phonemic and syntactic layers (ASR/NLP), rendering computer vision a secondary deduplication tool. This reduces the high-dimensional video tensor to a sparse, structured text vector. Second, we apply the LEAP operator to these vectors. LEAP functions as a localized Bayesian filter, extracting isolated likelihoods $L(D_i)$ from individual claims before aggregating them into story clusters. This prevents the 'wisdom of the crowd' fallacy by maintaining a rigorous Leave-One-Out ($\Delta_j$) audit trail, ensuring that clustered updates do not mask individual source biases. Third, we encounter the profound isomorphism of the Dual-Domain HHI. In the physical domain (GSE), quarterback targeting efficiency is modeled as a probability simplex, where the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index measures the concentration of passes across receivers, adjusted for situational deltas like Effective Numerical Advantage (EffN). Remarkably, the exact same quadratic form applies to the social domain (GSI), where expert opinions form a simplex, and their $	au$-weighted directional agreement yields an opinion concentration HHI. The bridge primitive connects these two manifolds: the physical HHI serves as the profile-anchored prior ($\mu_0$) for the social aggregator. If a quarterback physically distributes targets uniformly (low HHI), but experts unanimously predict a specific receiver (high opinion HHI), the resulting divergence generates a high-confidence alpha signal. The system's failure modes are explicitly gated: recalibration is forbidden until resolution (the LAUNCH_FINISH_LINE mandate), and margin gating ensures that analogies are re-proven against strict feasibility arithmetic before deployment.

The LEAP mechanism echoes the historical development of sequential analysis by Wald, updated with contemporary conformal prediction techniques to guarantee finite-sample coverage. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agents—sportsbooks and rival quants—as efficient markets that rapidly absorb public sentiment. Our decision actors (the curated expert registry) operate with delayed but deeper information access. The system assumes these actors possess bounded rationality; they might misprice events if they rely on viral video clips rather than transcript-level nuance. By modeling their likely reliance on weak visual cues, our transcript-first approach exploits their blind spots.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict anti-collinearity veto is enforced between the physical and social layers. If the physical HHI and opinion HHI move in perfect lockstep, the marginal value of the social layer collapses to zero, triggering a weight decay. Furthermore, any feature derived from viral video clips is automatically vetoed if it exhibits high correlation with low-confidence ASR segments, preventing leakage from the noisy visual regime into the clean textual trust lane.
